title: About ICST: Quality & Innovation in Thailand
description: Discover how ICST delivers innovative, customer-centric solutions tailored for the Thai market. Learn about our commitment to quality, reliability, and excellence in every project.

paragraphs: Engineering Innovative and Environmentally Sustainable Industrial

sections.heading: Global Presence
paragraphs: We are committed to serving all stakeholders, including customers, employees, suppliers, and communities.

sections.heading: Our Team
paragraphs: Some of our key clients include Shell, Star Energy, Shintech, ShinETSU, TTCL, PTT Group, Pertamina, Mitsubishi, and Marubeni.

We are strongly committed to these values and seek to provide customers with a complete and innovative choice of cooling solutions for the power, geothermal, refining, petrochemical, chemical, pulp & paper, steel/metals and basic process industries.
A key component in our philosophy is the overall quality of experience our customers realize when working with us.

sections.heading: Global Presence, Local Expertise
paragraphs: Delivering innovative cooling solutions across Asia.

sections.heading: ICST in Thailand
paragraphs: The facility handles key design, engineering, procurement, and management functions, along with construction and comprehensive after-sales services.

ICST provides full technical support for new cooling towers, repair and reconstruction, as well as thermal and structural upgrades. Additionally, we offer high-quality cooling tower spare parts for all makes and models at competitive prices to support industries across Thailand and the region.

sections.heading: ICST in Japan
paragraphs: Our team specializes in design, engineering, procurement, and project management, supporting quality construction and after-sales services.

ICST Japan provides comprehensive technical support for new cooling towers, repair and reconstruction, as well as thermal and structural upgrades. We also offer a full range of cooling tower spare parts for all makes and models at highly competitive prices to meet the needs of Japan’s industrial sector.
Our team manages key design, engineering, procurement, and project execution, ensuring efficient construction and after-sales services.
Additionally, we offer high-quality cooling tower spare parts for all makes and models at competitive prices to support industries throughout the Kingdom.
